item.title: Read The Top News Headlines For Sunday 4 January In One Click
item.description: Stay updated with the biggest headlines for Sunday, 4 January- politics, crime, sports, and more - all summarized for quick reading. Get instant access to breaking news, major developments, and trending stories in just one click. Perfect for busy readers who want news on the go.

item.title: Gold Prices Surge: Yellow metal up Rs 760 in a week amid global uncertainty
item.description: Gold prices continued their upward trend as 24-carat gold rose by ₹750–760 per 10 grams in a week, while silver surged ₹3,100 per kg. Strong global cues, record international prices, and rising investment demand supported the rally.

item.title: AI-based horoscope predicts big success for Virgo; Discipline and panning are the key
item.description: Virgo Horoscope 2026 reveals a rewarding year driven by discipline, planning, and consistent efforts. AI-based predictions suggest career growth, promotions, financial stability, and strong relationships for Virgo natives. Health needs attention, especially digestion and skin.

item.title: Folk Singer Neha Singh Rathore questioned over Pahalgam attack social media post? Latest update
item.description: Lucknow Police have initiated an investigation against folk singer Neha Singh Rathore over an alleged inflammatory social media post linked to the Pahalgam terror attack. An FIR was registered at Hazratganj police station citing concerns over communal harmony and national integrity.

item.title: New York Mayor slams US action over arrest of Venezuela’s President Maduro; Full details
item.description: New York Mayor criticises the US military action involving the arrest of Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, calling it a violation of international law and national sovereignty. The statement came after President Donald Trump’s announcement, triggering global reactions and concern among the Venezuelan community in New York.

item.title: Who Is Delcy Rodriguez? Venezuela’s New Interim President Explained
item.description: Delcy Rodriguez has been appointed as Venezuela’s interim president following the detention of President Nicolás Maduro by the United States. The Supreme Court cited administrative continuity and national security as reasons for the move.

item.title: Magh Mela 2026: Why it is called the Mini Kumbh? Kalpvas explained
item.description: Magh Mela 2026 is a major Hindu religious gathering held annually at the Triveni Sangam in Prayagraj. Often called the Mini Kumbh, the fair is known for sacred bathing rituals, Kalpvas, and spiritual discipline observed during the Magh month.

item.title: Odisha: Several killed in stone quarry explosion in Dhenkanal; Rescue operation underway
item.description: Odapada tehsildar and Motanga police have rushed to the site. The investigation is going on to determine whether explosive materials used for blasting were still there at the site.

item.title: Owaisi Challenges Modi: ‘If your chest is 56 inches, bring 26/11 terrorists from Pak’ after US arrests Maduro
item.description: AIMIM chief Owaisi challenges PM Modi over 26/11 terrorists, cites US military action against Venezuelan President Maduro, questions Indian government on bringing Masood Azhar.

item.title: Gurmeet Ram Rahim granted 40-day parole again; Full inside story
item.description: Earlier, Ram Rahim was released on 40-day parole in August last year. During that time, he delivered sermons at the Dera headquarters along with satsangs (religious gatherings).
